examples.text: Amo el olor de hot cakes por la mañana.
examples.en: I love the smell of pancakes in the morning.

examples.text: Llevaré dos hot dogs con mostaza y ketchup.
examples.en: I'll have two hot dogs with mustard and ketchup.

examples.text: Por favor dame dos hot dogs con mostaza y salsa de tomate.
examples.en: Please give me two hot dogs with mustard and ketchup.
